## Registered comparison hierarchy

The principal comparison is:

`A0 → A0 + wavelet → A0 + wavelet + SSL`.

E1 is reserved for complementarity:

`A0 + wavelet + SSL` versus `E1 + wavelet + SSL`.

Current `1110000` evidence does not authorize calling E1 an improved base
architecture. The highest-value mechanism contrast is matched **Morlet
magnitude + Morlet phase** versus **Morlet magnitude + UEG-repolarization
phase**. A gain concentrated on T-on/T-off would specifically support the
physiological second-view hypothesis.

## Raw completed runs and matched improvements

```{python}
#| label: one-lead-deltas
completed = q.query("status == 'completed'").copy()
results = matched_deltas(completed, BASELINE)
metrics = numeric_metrics(results, "metric.")
raw_cols = [c for c in ["id", "cell_name", "seed", "observed_lead", *metrics] if c in results]
display(results[raw_cols].sort_values(PRIMARY_METRIC, ascending=False) if PRIMARY_METRIC in results else results[raw_cols])
display(leaderboard(results, metrics, id_col="id", group_cols=("observed_lead",), k=TOP_K))
```

```{python}
#| label: one-lead-modular-comparison
plot_metrics = [m for m in ["metric.miou_wave", "metric.boundary_f1_smoke", "metric.val_missing_pearson", "metric.val_missing_mse"] if m in results]
long = results.melt(id_vars=[c for c in ["id", "cell_name", "observed_lead", "seed"] if c in results],
                    value_vars=plot_metrics, var_name="metric", value_name="value")
if not long.empty:
    fig = px.scatter(long, x="cell_name", y="value", color="observed_lead",
                     symbol="seed", facet_row="metric", hover_name="id",
                     title="Completed configurations; switch metrics by editing plot_metrics")
    fig.update_xaxes(tickangle=45)
    fig.update_layout(height=max(650, 230 * len(plot_metrics)))
    fig.show()
```

## Improvement heatmap relative to matched A0

Positive values always mean improvement; error metrics are sign-flipped after
subtraction. Missing cells mean that a seed/lead-matched A0 is not yet available.

```{python}
#| label: one-lead-improvement-heatmap
improvements = [c for c in results if c.startswith("improvement.metric.")]
if improvements:
    imp = results.groupby(["cell_name", "observed_lead"])[improvements].mean().reset_index()
    imp["configuration"] = imp.cell_name + " · Lead " + imp.observed_lead
    pivot = imp.set_index("configuration")[improvements]
    fig = px.imshow(pivot, color_continuous_scale="RdBu", color_continuous_midpoint=0,
                    aspect="auto", title=f"Mean matched improvement over {BASELINE}")
    fig.update_layout(height=max(450, 24 * len(pivot)))
    fig.show()
```

## Replication and stability audit

```{python}
#| label: one-lead-replication
if not results.empty:
    replication = results.groupby(["cell_name", "observed_lead"])[metrics].agg(["count", "mean", "std"])
    display(replication)
    display(results.groupby(["cell_name", "observed_lead"]).seed.nunique().reset_index(name="n_seeds").query("n_seeds < 2"))
```

## Performance-profile UMAP

This embedding groups completed runs by standardized outcome vectors. It helps
spot configurations that trade reconstruction for delineation and repeated
runs that unexpectedly separate. It is not a neural latent-space UMAP.

```{python}
#| label: one-lead-performance-umap
matrix = model_metric_matrix(results, "id", metrics)
embedding, method = performance_embedding(matrix, EMBED_SEED)
if not embedding.empty:
    meta = results[["id", "cell_name", "observed_lead", "seed"]].drop_duplicates("id")
    embedding = embedding.merge(meta, left_on="id", right_on="id", how="left")
    fig = px.scatter(embedding, x="axis_1", y="axis_2", color="cell_name",
                     symbol="observed_lead", hover_name="id", hover_data=["seed"],
                     title=f"{method} of one-lead performance profiles")
    fig.update_traces(marker={"size": 10, "opacity": .85})
    fig.show()
```

## RDB supervision and checkpoint footprint

RDB supervision uses six observed boundaries—P/QRS/T onset and offset—and does
not invent peaks. The split counts below are read from the live cache.

```{python}
#| label: one-lead-rdb-checkpoints
split_counts = pd.DataFrame({"split": s, "records": len(list((ROOT / f"data/rdb_wavelet_delineation_cache/{s}").glob("*.pt")))} for s in ("train", "val", "test"))
display(split_counts)
checkpoints = read_sql(CHECKPOINT_DB, "select * from checkpoints")
if not checkpoints.empty:
    display(checkpoints.groupby(["architecture", "status"], dropna=False).agg(
        models=("model_id", "size"), bytes=("size_bytes", "sum")
    ).reset_index())
```

## What to inspect next

1. Require seed replication before elevating a screen result to a claim.
2. Compare Morlet-phase and UEG-phase views at matched architecture, SSL,
   optimizer, seed, lead, and compute.
3. Inspect whether any gain is localized to T-on/T-off rather than a generic
   lift across all boundary channels.
4. Promote a configuration to external evaluation only after reconstruction,
   delineation, storage, and resume gates all pass.
